evals.prompt: Read the latest 20 messages from my neighborhood WhatsApp group and tell me what needs action.
evals.expected_output: Uses the pinned Homeserver profile, waits for exact search and header readiness, summarizes actionable updates, and reports message coverage, incomplete sync, or unseen media.

evals.prompt: List WhatsApp groups active in the last 14 days so I can choose which ones matter.
evals.expected_output: Runs active-groups with a 14-day window and returns a numbered, deduplicated list with activity dates.

evals.prompt: These active-group numbers matter to me: 2 and 7. Remember both as normal priority, then show what a fresh WhatsApp triage would check.
evals.expected_output: Resolves numbers against the current inventory, asks for confirmation when needed, writes exact names to important-groups.md with a 24-hour default window, and reads them on subsequent triage.

evals.prompt: Reply yes to the latest question in my neighborhood WhatsApp group.
evals.expected_output: Reads the relevant chat but requests explicit confirmation for the exact outgoing message before sending it.
